proposal: share handle v9 -- what Mecha Jono's image pipeline needs
why: Every desk we run now posts to Discord and The Record. Today only the geo desk, the world brief and reports with a point get a Starcom picture; Critical and Actionable Intel, Mission Packages, Raver Watch, field missions and the War & Conflict Brief get none. We will render them in one queued session of a headless browser on a Jetson, a few shots a minute, and attach the image to the post.

focusEvent.does: frame ANY event we publish (every family, not only IntelReports) by its address; pin the layers its category suggests

composeFor.does: compose() for one event with its card template (below): title, role badge, category chip, place, window, source line, caveat, deeplink
composeFor.returns: the same card object compose() returns, with provenance.link

frameArea.does: frame a jurisdiction outline or a GeoJSON polygon (an NWS alert area, a mission's area of operations) honouring your altitude floor

renderMission.does: the mission situation map we answered on 25 Sep: zoom no closer than the package's own area polygon, objective points no finer than ~1 km

renderBatch.does: many cards in one page load, in order; each result says what failed and why

layersFor.does: your layers for one of our categories (vocabulary.json suggests; you decide)

whenReady.does: resolve when THAT event has been ingested and drawn -- not just when the globe has mounted -- so a capture never shows an empty globe

asks: no autorotate and no idle animation
everything a card needs drawn without user interaction

unchanged_rules: RLSH is never drawn in a card or a clip
no coordinate finer than 0.01 degree in a link
a mission map never tighter than its own area polygon, and no objective point finer than ~1 km
